hook: Ivan Zhang studied computer science at the University of Toronto, graduating in 2016, and worked as an engineer across biotech and MLOps roles before co-founding the research collective for.ai in 2017. In 2019 he co-founded Cohere alongside Aidan Gomez and Nick Frosst, building the company into an enterprise-focused large language model provider. As co-founder and Chief Technology Officer, Zhang has overseen technical product development at Cohere and worked closely with the company's public sector and government customers. For.ai, the research group he started before Cohere, was later folded into Cohere as its open research division, Cohere Labs. He has co-authored research spanning generative adversarial networks, model regularization and AI safety.
